items: Used to form verbs from nouns, adjectives, or foreign verbs. — штраф (“fine”) + -овать → штрафова́ть (“to fine”); ревность (“jealousy”) + -овать → ревнова́ть (“to be jealous”); integrieren (“to integrate”) + -овать → интегри́ровать (“to integrate”)

blocks.text: This suffix is very frequently added to German words ending in -ieren (borrowed in turn from French -er), producing the combined suffix -и́ровать, which has taken on a life of its own.

items: Used to form verbs from nouns and adjectives whose stem ends in a palatal consonant, a hushing consonant (ш ж ч щ) or ц. — го́ре (“grief”) + -евать → горева́ть (“to grieve, to mourn”); та́нец (“dance”) + -евать → танцева́ть (“to dance”); ночь (“night”) + -евать → ночева́ть (“to spend the night”)
